thread:
matt: Quick 1-question watercooler poll — favorite model nickname? Reply with an emoji or drop your own. I'll tally by emoji. Options: :monkey: Monk, :fox_face: Vulp, :robot_face: Robo, :owl: Athena. Poll closes at 3pm PT.
zoe: Vulp for me 🦊 (short and cute).
raj: Robo :robot_face: — feels practical.
sophia: Athena :owl: because bias audits > everything.
olivia: Monk :monkey: — reminds me of tiny debug rituals.
matt: Noted. also if you want a new suggestion, drop it now.
raj: Also proposing "Sparrow" for small models.
zoe: +1 Sparrow — sounds nimble.
sophia: lol Sparrow is adorable.
matt: Cool. Closing in 5. Anyone last votes?
olivia: voting Vulp with :fox_face:.
lunchbot: Poll results snapshot — counted reactions and explicit replies: :fox_face: Vulp (3), :robot_face: Robo (1), :owl: Athena (1), :monkey: Monk (1), other: Sparrow (2).
matt: Nice, Vulp wins the informal poll. I'll put the top three in the #announcements draft for the Slack emoji pack. :tada:
zoe: yay! thanks for organizing the chaos.
raj: good stuff. can we do snacks next week? :popcorn:
sophia: yes please snacks.
matt: noted — snack poll next Tuesday.
